name: 墨蓝·卫报
description: 源自 rico-md 的「墨蓝·卫报」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 14px 44px 14px; font-family: -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Noto Sans SC, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.72; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 26px; font-weight: 900; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.2; margin: 24px 0 14px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 3px solid {{codeText}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 22px 0 10px; padding: 8px 12px; background-color: {{codeBg}}; border-left: 4px solid {{codeText}}">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 16px 0 6px; border-left: 3px solid {{accent}}; padding-left: 10px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{heading}}; color: #fff; padding: 9px 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}
